heading: Module 6: Income Tax Withholding System
context: The residence switch is prospective, never retroactive. DIAN Concepto 011108 of 2026 rejected the argument that a foreign employee on a contract exceeding 183 days may be withheld under art. 383 from day one in anticipation of future residence. Withholding is determined at the moment of each payment
changes: The 20% rate is lawful only while the employee is in fact a non-resident. A client instruction, even in writing, does not shift the liability: where the withholding is not made, the withholding agent answers for the amount it was required to withhold, with a right of reimbursement against the taxpayer, and any penalty is the agent's alone (Tax Code art. 370).
